answer:
Your October budget note now has a page. It shows:

- **Total vs limit:** 12,357.50 kr spent, with 2,642.50 kr left of your 15,000 kr limit. A bar above the category list shows the same split.
- **By category:** each category's amount and percentage, largest first.
- **Quick add:** a form with What, Amount and Category. New expenses are dated today and added to the note's table. You can also change the limit there.
- **Latest:** your most recent expenses.

To make this work, I rewrote the note's bullet list as a table (Date, Item, Category, Amount) with the same eight expenses. I also set the 15,000 kr limit in the page's data. I kept the "Limit this month" line in the note, but it's now only text. The page reads the limit from its own data, so change it on the page, not in the text.

The page has a month picker. It will appear once the table has rows from more than one month.
